posts.text: What a tumultuous journey it has been in AI CPU/GPU space. From GPU to Memory to CPU. Now we have a new entrant ASICs. All in all AMD continues to execute exactly like they should. They literally got the seat at the table in the high stakes AI infrastructure world. Lisa Su was at the table with Xi, Jensen, Tim Cook and Elon at the white house. I would say the warrants deal with OpenAI and Meta was worth it.
